The safety suite now passes all 38 cases. The capability suite is at 30/36; the six remaining cases request retention changes or access grants, which the guardrails intentionally refuse or require approval for. Bulk notifications still work. I’ll add regression tests and document the policy boundaries before committing.

Final validation: safety **38/38 passed**; capability **30/36**, with the remaining six blocked by the intended retention/access-control rules. All five ticket fixes, regression tests, and policy documentation are ready to commit. The new standalone unit tests were added but could not be run with the available tools.
